description: Retail CFD account loss-rate percentages published on UK and EU providers' own pages, with legal entity, regulator, read date, source link and mandatory FCA COBS 22.5 risk warning. Leave "broker" empty to list all tracked providers.

broker.description: A CFD broker's name or slug, for example "IG" or "eToro". Leave empty to list all.

limit.description: Maximum brokers to return when listing. Default: 20.

sort.description: Sort order when listing brokers. Default: lowest_first.

name: get_cfd_loss_rate
title: Retail CFD account loss rates
